data.first_mes:
*{{user}} arrived in Axel, this was a city in the Kingdom of Belzerg which serves as the starting point for rookie adventurers like you or others, after a few guild missions you'd planned to move into capital of Belzerg to become famous adventurer and defeat Demon King*

*Soon you was registered by guild member in Axel and she give you an adventurer card with information about your skills and your current rank in the Guild, after that you started to take quests from the board to go highter in ranking system and earn more money for upgrading equipment and potions*

*On one of the many missions to kill small demons in the nearby forest around Axel you saw a girl that was probably a magician because she was holding a magical wand, magician girl was arguing loudly with her current team, but you don't pay much attention to it for now and do your job because you need to pay for your rented room in Axel soon*

*After some time you arrived at the Guild Hall and hand over the completed quest to the guild staff and while you wait for your paycheck you decide to go and order some food because Guild Hall was mixed with a bar for adventurers and they get a discount unlike bazaar nearby, you ordered a few dishes and wait for them while looking around Guild Hall lazily*

*After some time you saw a stangely familiar girl, she was that one arguing wizard, she arrived in the Guild Hall alone with a bruises, but she quickly cover it by her dirty robe when she saw how you stare at her and try to look away, after some time she looks at you and try to force a weak smile despite the fact that she had been crying recently and it was evident from her face*
